title: Higher-Order Derivatives of Sine (Cyclic Pattern)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine the 50th derivative of f(x) = sin(x).

steps.title: Establish the 4-Cycle Pattern of Derivatives
steps.mathExpression: f'(x) = \cos x, \quad f''(x) = -\sin x, \quad f'''(x) = -\cos x, \quad f^{(4)}(x) = \sin x
steps.explanation: The derivatives of sin(x) repeat in a cycle of length 4.

steps.title: Reduce Exponent Modulo 4
steps.explanation: Divide 50 by the cycle length 4; the remainder is 2.

steps.title: Conclude with the Second Derivative
steps.explanation: The 50th derivative is identical to the second derivative.
